items.name: stepper-001
items.title: Шаги процесса
items.description: Индикатор шагов, где пройденное отмечено галочкой, а не только цветом. Линия заполнена до текущего шага, поэтому прогресс виден без чтения подписей.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-stepper-001-*. Состояние шага (done, current, todo) выводится из пропа current и попадает в data-атрибут, от которого зависят и кружок, и линия. Линия — ::before у каждого шага кроме первого, она тянется от центра предыдущего кружка. Текущий шаг помечен aria-current="step". В узкой колонке подсказки скрываются через @container, остаются кружки и подписи.

ai.usage:
<Stepper001
  current={2}
  steps={[
    { label: "Проект", hint: "Название и адрес" },
    { label: "Дизайн" },
    { label: "Публикация" },
  ]}
/>
ai.summary: Индикатор шагов процесса: кружки с номерами, галочка вместо номера у пройденных, подписи и необязательные подсказки. Линия между шагами заполнена до текущего. Состояние выводится из одного числа, поэтому рассинхронизировать шаги невозможно. Ноль зависимостей, один файл, своя палитра, клиентского JS нет.

Это индикатор, а не навигация: шаги не кликаются. Если по шагам нужно возвращаться, оберните подписи в ссылки в своей копии.

en.title: Process Stepper
en.description: A step indicator where completed steps are marked with a check, not colour alone. The line fills up to the current step, so progress reads without reading the labels.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-stepper-001-* variables. The step state (done, current, todo) is derived from the current prop and lands in a data attribute, which drives both the circle and the line. The line is a ::before on every step except the first, reaching back from the previous circle's centre. The current step is marked aria-current="step". In a narrow column the hints are hidden through @container, leaving the circles and the labels.

ai.summary: A process stepper: numbered circles, a check instead of the number on completed steps, labels and optional hints. The connecting line is filled up to the current step. Every state is derived from one number, so the steps cannot fall out of sync. Zero dependencies, one file, its own palette, no client JS.

the connecting line as ::before reaching back to the previous circle's centre: a separate line element drifts when the row wraps
aria-current="step" on the current step — it is how a screen reader locates the position in the process
the @container query that hides the hints in a narrow column: otherwise the labels collide
the <style> block inside the component — it holds the palette, the circles and the line
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own

the accent through the accent prop — it colours completed circles and the line

notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
This is an indicator, not navigation: the steps are not clickable. If people must go back, wrap the labels in links in your copy.
Do not go past five steps: a long process is better split into stages, or the labels stop fitting.
A final "Done" step is unnecessary: the last step is the completion.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the component has to stay a single file.

  ]}
/>

items.title: Шаги-шевроны
items.description: Лента шагов для оформления заказа или анкеты: пройденные отмечены галочкой, текущий выделен. Меняются шаги, подписи и номер текущего.

Форма шеврона получается одним clip-path на пункте — вырез слева и остриё справа, — поэтому дополнительных узлов и псевдоэлементов под стрелку не нужно, а соседний пункт наезжает отрицательным margin. en.title: Chevron Steps
en.description: A step ribbon for a checkout or a form: finished steps carry a check mark and the current one stands out. Change the steps, the labels and which one is current.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the --vibeui-stepper-002-* variables. Server component: no hooks. The chevron shape comes from a single clip-path on the item — a notch on the left and a point on the right — so no extra nodes or pseudo-elements are needed for the arrow, and the neighbouring item overlaps it with a negative margin. The current step is marked aria-current="step"; each item's state is duplicated by a visually hidden phrase, because a fill colour conveys nothing on its own. A container query measures the width: below 32rem the labels of inactive steps are hidden, leaving the numbers and the check marks.

en.title: Vertical Steps
en.description: A vertical step list where every step has room for an explanation and a timestamp, and its state is spelled out in a word beside the title.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the --vibeui-stepper-003-* variables. Server component: no hooks. An item is a two-column grid: the circle takes the first column across all rows (grid-row: 1 / span 3) and the text goes into the second, so the description and the time align to the title without manual indents. The connecting line is the item's ::before: it starts under the circle and stops at the last step, so it does not dangle into empty space. The current step is marked aria-current="step", and each item's state is duplicated by the caption "Done / Now / Ahead": the line colour is not the only carrier of meaning.

The connector takes its colour from the left-hand neighbour through an inline variable, so the break shows exactly where the error is. A skipped step is additionally marked with a dashed border: shape works where colour does not.

items.name: stepper-005
items.title: Прогресс на соединителе
items.description: Шаги, где прогресс живёт внутри соединителя: линия перед текущим шагом залита не целиком, а на долю готовности, и та же доля напечатана числом.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, палитра в переменных --vibeui-stepper-005-*. Серверный: хуков нет. Дорожка и заливка соединителя — два псевдоэлемента одного пункта; ширина заливки считается как calc(100% * var(--vibeui-stepper-005-fill)), где переменная приходит инлайново безразмерным числом: умножать проценты на проценты CSS не умеет. Пройденные шаги получают заливку 1, текущий — долю готовности, будущие 0. Процент продублирован текстом под кружком: полоска для скринридера не существует. Текущий шаг помечен aria-current="step", пройденные — галочкой и словом «Готово».

en.title: Connector Progress
en.description: Steps where the progress lives inside the connector: the line before the current step is filled only part of the way, and the same fraction is printed as a number.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the --vibeui-stepper-005-* variables. Server component: no hooks. The connector's track and fill are two pseudo-elements of the same item; the fill width is computed as calc(100% * var(--vibeui-stepper-005-fill)), where the variable arrives inline as a unitless number: CSS cannot multiply percentages by percentages. Completed steps get a fill of 1, the current one gets its readiness fraction and future ones get 0. The percentage is duplicated as text under the circle: a bar does not exist for a screen reader. The current step is marked aria-current="step", completed ones carry a check mark and the word "Done".

items.name: stepper-006
items.title: Счётчик на телефоне
items.description: Компактный индикатор для телефона: счётчик «шаг 2 из 5», название текущего шага, подсказка про следующий и полоски-сегменты вместо ленты подписей.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, палитра в переменных --vibeui-stepper-006-*. Серверный: хуков нет. На ширине телефона пять подписей не помещаются, поэтому вместо ленты выводится счётчик и одно название — крупно. Сегменты остаются ol: каждый пункт несёт своё состояние и визуально скрытую фразу, поэтому индикатор озвучивается как список шагов, а не как декоративная полоса. Текущий сегмент помечен aria-current="step" и растянут flex-grow, поэтому позиция читается и без чтения счётчика. Номер шага зажимается в границы массива: current вне диапазона не даст пустого заголовка.

en.title: Mobile Counter
en.description: A compact indicator for phones: a "step 2 of 5" counter, the current step's name, a hint about the next one, and segment bars instead of a ribbon of labels.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the --vibeui-stepper-006-* variables. Server component: no hooks. At phone width five labels do not fit, so instead of the ribbon it prints a counter and one title in large type. The segments stay an ol: each item carries its own state and a visually hidden phrase, so the indicator is announced as a list of steps rather than as a decorative bar. The current segment is marked aria-current="step" and stretched with flex-grow, so the position reads without reading the counter. The step number is clamped to the array bounds: a current outside the range will not produce an empty title.

items.title: Шаги оформления
items.description: Шаги оформления заказа, к которым можно вернуться: пройденный шаг показывает выбранное значение и ссылку возврата, будущий остаётся текстом, а не отключённой кнопкой.

Пройденный шаг печатает выбранное значение, поэтому список работает и как сводка заказа. en.title: Checkout Steps
en.description: Checkout steps you can go back to: a finished step shows the chosen value and a return link, while an upcoming one stays plain text instead of a disabled button.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the --vibeui-stepper-007-* variables. Server component: no hooks, going back is done with ordinary links. A completed step prints the chosen value, so the list works as an order summary as well. The return link has an accessible name of the form "Edit: delivery": in a list of four links the same word "Edit" is useless. Upcoming steps deliberately do not pretend to be disabled buttons — they are text captioned "Ahead" that does not take focus and does not promise a press. An item is a three-column grid with the glyph and the right-hand block pinned to their own columns, so the row does not fall apart when there is no value.

en.title: Optional Steps
en.description: Steps with optional stages among them: those are marked with a word and a dashed outline, while the counter on top counts only the required ones so the progress does not lie.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the --vibeui-stepper-008-* variables. Server component: the required steps are counted at render. Optionality is marked three times: by a word in the label, by the item's dashed border and by a dashed circle — colour plays no part here at all. The counter at the top deliberately counts required steps only: "2 of 6" is intimidating when four steps can be skipped. The items sit in a wrapping ol, so a long list does not run off into a scroll but rebuilds into several rows. The current step is marked aria-current="step", and the states are duplicated by a hidden phrase.

en.title: Setup Steps
en.description: An install guide as steps: the command is shown only inside the step being performed right now, while the others collapse to a title and a state.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the --vibeui-stepper-009-* variables. Server component: no hooks, the expansion is decided by the step number rather than by a click. The code sits in pre + code with tabIndex={0}: without focus a long command cannot be scrolled from the keyboard, and horizontal scrolling stays the only way to see it in full. The dark code block carries its own background and monospace font variables, so it does not depend on the project's theme. The current step is marked aria-current="step", the states are captioned with the words "Done / Now / Ahead", and the line on the left is coloured only along the completed stretch.

items.title: Шаги с подробностями
items.description: Вертикальные шаги с короткой сводкой у каждого и развёрнутой панелью подробностей у текущего шага — детали видны только тогда, когда до них дошла очередь.

Кружок растянут на все строки пункта через grid-row:1 / span 3, поэтому высота ряда не завязана на количество текста; форма 1 / -1 здесь не годится — явных строк у пункта нет, и -1 указывает на первую же линию, после чего текст сваливается в колонку кружка. en.title: Detail Steps
en.description: Vertical steps with a one-line summary on each and an expanded detail panel on the current one — details show only once their turn has come.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the --vibeui-stepper-010-* variables. Server component: no hooks. The detail panel is a separate data-part="panel" block, rendered only when the step's state is current and it has a details array; on the other steps only the title and a one-line summary are visible. The current step is marked aria-current="step", and the state is duplicated by a word next to the title.

en.title: Progress Counter
en.description: A "step 2 of 5" numeric indicator with a percentage and a continuous progress bar — a compact stand-in for a ribbon when there is nowhere to put step names.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the --vibeui-stepper-013-* variables. Server component: no hooks. items.name: stepper-016
items.title: Прогресс по шагам
items.description: Полоса шагов, где заливка трека доезжает до следующего узла пружиной, а сам узел в этот момент хлопает. Кнопки «Назад» и «Далее» ведут по цепочке.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, ноль зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-stepper-016-*. Клиентский: "use client" ради состояния текущего шага. Заливка тянется одним элементом через scaleX(var(--vibeui-stepper-016-progress)) с пружинной кривой linear() — transform не пересчитывает раскладку, поэтому пружина идёт ровно и на длинном списке. Трек начинается в центре первого узла и кончается в центре последнего: отступ --vibeui-stepper-016-inset считается от числа шагов, а не от ширины узла, потому что узлы делят строку поровну. Пройденные шаги показывают галочку вместо номера, текущий получает scale и aria-current="step". Тема — light-dark() плюс правило :where(.dark,[data-theme="dark"]) … {color-scheme:dark}.

en.title: Step Progress
en.description: A step bar where the track fill springs across to the next node while the node itself pops. Back and Next buttons walk the chain.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-stepper-016-* variables. Client-side: "use client" for the current-step state. The fill is a single element stretched with scaleX(var(--vibeui-stepper-016-progress)) on a linear() spring curve — transform does not trigger layout, so the spring stays smooth even on a long list. The track starts at the centre of the first node and ends at the centre of the last: the --vibeui-stepper-016-inset offset is derived from the number of steps rather than from the node width, because the nodes split the row evenly. Completed steps show a check instead of a number, and the current one gets a scale and aria-current="step". The theme comes from light-dark() plus the :where(.dark,[data-theme="dark"]) … {color-scheme:dark} rule.

en.title: Two-Sided Milestones
en.description: A vertical milestone ribbon on both sides of a shared trunk: odd entries on the left, even ones on the right. At a narrow width both sides collapse into one column against the left edge, with no horizontal scrolling.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the local --vibeui-timeline-013-* variables. Server component: no hooks. The trunk is the list's pseudo-element (ol::before), not a border on each milestone. In a narrow container, li is a two-column grid (node, card), and every card sits by the right edge of the trunk. From a 30rem container width the trunk moves to the centre, li switches to three columns, and cards split by parity: nth-child(odd) goes left of the trunk with right-aligned text, nth-child(even) goes right with left-aligned text. The switch runs on the block's own container-type rather than a viewport media query, so the layout follows the parent's width.
